en.h2: Bill Splitter: paste the receipt, tap who ordered what, and see what everyone owes
en.lead: In short: a free tool for splitting a restaurant bill. Log each dish and tap who ordered it. Shared dishes are split evenly, and the service charge and discounts are shared in proportion to what each person ordered. You can also let the birthday person eat for free. Share the result as a link or text so everyone can pay back whoever covered the bill.
en.pills: By item or split evenlyProportional service chargeBirthday person pays nothingPaste a receipt to add itemsAdd to home screen ↓
en.roP: Only the person who started this bill can edit it. Payment status reflects the latest link they shared.
en.tplL: Common situations — tap to see an example:
en.bXopen: Paste receipt text to add items
en.lWho: Who ordered it? (pick several to split)
en.evenNote: The total is split among everyone who pays. Set a birthday person or guest in the next step.
en.lBill: Total on the receipt (optional, to double-check)
en.lPay: Who paid the bill? (everyone pays them back)
en.rdC10: Round up to 10 (the payer never loses out)
en.ownP: Only you (the organizer) can edit this bill. Friends who open the link can only view it. When someone pays you, tap “Got it” above, then “Share with the group” so everyone can see who has paid.
en.bOwnLink: Switching phones? Copy your organizer link
en.privacy: Your bill lives only in your browser and in the share link. Receipt photos are never uploaded or added to the link.
en.c5: Planning the next meal? Check these deals
en.klook_s: Buffets, afternoon tea and view restaurants, often discounted
en.kkday_s: Themed restaurants, cooking classes, food tours
en.disc: These are affiliate links: I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. — Zoe
en.artnote: The how-to guide and FAQ on this page are in Chinese. Tap 中文 at the top to read them.
en.insH: Add the bill splitter to your home screen for next time
en.insP: Once added, it opens like an app from your home screen — nothing to download, no storage used. Open it when the bill arrives.
en.bPwa: Install to home screen in one tap
en.pIos:
iPhone: add to Home Screen (Safari)

  1. Open this page in Safari
  2. Tap the Share icon next to the address bar (a square with an up arrow; on newer iOS, tap “⋯” first)
  3. Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”
  4. Rename it if you like, then tap “Add”

iPhone: add to Favorites

  1. Tap the Share icon again
  2. Tap “Add to Favorites” — it will show up on Safari's start page
en.pIosC:
iPhone: add to Home Screen (Chrome)

  1. Open this page in Chrome
  2. Tap the Share icon on the right of the address bar (or tap “⋯” at the bottom right, then “Share”)
  3. Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”
  4. Tap “Add” — the icon appears on your home screen

iPhone: add a Chrome bookmark

  1. Tap “⋯” at the bottom right
  2. Tap “Add to Bookmarks” (shown as a ☆ in some versions)

“Add to Home Screen” in Chrome needs iOS 16.4 or later. If you don't see it, do it once in Safari.
en.pAnd:
Android: add to home screen (Chrome)

  1. Open this page in Chrome
  2. Tap the “⋮” menu at the top right
  3. Tap “Add to home screen”, then “Add” or “Create shortcut”

Android: bookmark it

  1. Tap “⋮” at the top right
  2. Tap the ☆ star in the top row

Samsung Internet: tap “≡” at the bottom → “Add page to” → “Home screen”.
en.pPc:
Computer: bookmark it

  1. Press Ctrl+D (Windows) or ⌘+D (Mac)
  2. Save it to your bookmarks bar for one-click access
en.insNote: For security, websites can't add themselves for you — the steps above take about 10 seconds.
en.invite: Find it useful? Share it with the friends you eat out with — no more passing a calculator around the table. Sharing it is the best way to support a free tool.
en.howto:
How do I copy text from a receipt photo?

iPhone: open the receipt in Photos, tap the Live Text icon at the bottom right (or press and hold the text) → Select All → Copy.

Android: open the receipt in Google Photos, tap Lens → Text → Select all → Copy text.

You can also point your camera at the receipt and tap the text frame when it appears.
